allow: PowerShell($urls = "/", "/sitemap.xml", "/robots.txt", "/manifest.webmanifest", "/blog", "/blog/arquitectura-percepcion", "/blog/adn-del-significado", "/blog/trono-de-la-decision", "/blog/influencia-sin-erosion", "/blog/psicologia-adopcion", "/blog/discovery-ia", "/blog/ux-fintech", "/blog/mvp-escala", "/portafolio", "/curso", "/llms.txt", "/llms-full.txt"; foreach \($u in $urls\) { try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:3000$u" -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 30; Write-Output "$\($r.StatusCode\)  $u" } catch { Write-Output "ERR   $u  $\($_.Exception.Message\)" } })

PowerShell(Write-Output "=== sitemap.xml ==="; \(Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:3000/sitemap.xml" -UseBasicParsing\).Content | Select-String -Pattern "<loc>" | ForEach-Object { $_.Line.Trim\(\) }; Write-Output ""; Write-Output "=== robots.txt ==="; \(Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:3000/robots.txt" -UseBasicParsing\).Content)
